results.migration: idempotent by IF NOT EXISTS, ON CONFLICT and guarded constraint creation
results.seed: synthetic platforms, game-platform links and metric definitions
results.parametrizedQueries: three SQL queries with named parameters

relationships: metric_definitions 1:N game_metrics by metric_name and unit

invariants: platform code, name and manufacturer are non-blank and code is unique
publication status is planned, available or retired
metric name and unit must match a registered metric definition
M01 metric ranges and foreign keys remain enforced

testCases.name: normal
testCases.expected: returns seeded PlayStation 5 games with rating at least 4.0

assumptions: Los identificadores de plataforma son codigos estables para integraciones.
Los datos del seed son sinteticos y solo sirven para pruebas reproducibles.
La API de M01 conserva metric_name y unit para compatibilidad.
El SHA y el resultado de Docker se completan en la entrega final del equipo.
limitations: No se ejecuta PostgreSQL automaticamente durante make verify.
El fallo declarado requiere una instancia PostgreSQL para observar el SQLSTATE.
El modelo no registra regiones ni ediciones de una misma plataforma.
